t: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-24 Hind
name: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-24 Hind — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-24 Hind
description: Introduction and overview of the Mil Mi-24 Hind: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Mil Mi-24 Hind is a twin-engine attack helicopter with a troop compartment — a flying infantry fighting vehicle — entering Soviet service in 1972. 2,648 were built; Hinds fought in Afghanistan, Africa, and the Middle East. Its armored, heavily armed design made it one of the most feared helicopters of the Cold War. Baseline facts: Attack helicopter with troop cabin; Soviet service from 1972; 2,648 built by Mil..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: Mil Mi-24 Hind: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Attack helicopter with troop cabin; Soviet service from 1972; 2,648 built by Mil.
